name: state-dynamics-engine
description: Deterministic state simulation with inspectable updates, memory, noise, and reproducible traces.

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types tests/determinism.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tests/migration-parity.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types tests/compatibility.mjs && npm run test:memory-policy
scripts.run: node --experimental-strip-types -e "import { run } from './src/engine.ts'; const r = run(32, '0x51e1d'); console.log(r.frames.at(-1));"
scripts.install:apps: npm --prefix apps/simulator ci && npm --prefix apps/memory-weather-lab ci
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm --prefix apps/simulator run check && npm --prefix apps/memory-weather run verify && npm --prefix apps/memory-weather-lab run verify && npm run check:ascii
scripts.build:site: npm --prefix apps/simulator run build && npm --prefix apps/memory-weather run build && npm --prefix apps/memory-weather-lab run build && node scripts/assemble-pages-site.mjs && node scripts/verify-pages-site.mjs

author: Donald Tuttle
